answer: Gate each identity behind a verifiable delay function: a strictly sequential computation seeded by the epoch beacon that takes a fixed wall-clock span no parallel hardware can shorten, yet verifies in a blink. One honest agent crosses this bridge once per epoch. An operator fielding a thousand personas cannot fan them across cores like a flock of sparrows; each persona needs its own sequential run, so a farm pays delay times headcount, never amortized. The proof is an ivory-hard chain of repeated squaring in a group where no shortcut is known. Capital buys no leverage, only linear cost.
